e.title: OasisLMF
e.summary: 开源巨灾建模框架（Oasis Loss Modelling Framework）：商业 RMS/Verisk 的开源替代
e.body: OasisLMF 是开源巨灾建模框架（Loss Modelling Framework）：地震/风暴/洪水等巨灾损失建模的标准开源平台，行业广泛采用（商业 RMS/Verisk 模型的开源替代）。对 RIAA：巨灾建模职业路径（[[catastrophe-modeler]] 岗位词条）的核心工具认知——开源自托管巨灾模型；与 [[reinsurance]] 概念、[[openirm]]（Solvency II）构成「风险建模开源栈」。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：仓库确认（开源损失建模框架，157★），未实测
e.summary_en: Open-source catastrophe modelling framework (Oasis Loss Modelling Framework): the open alternative to commercial RMS/Verisk models
e.summary_hk: 開源巨災建模框架（Oasis Loss Modelling Framework）：商業 RMS/Verisk 的開源替代
e.body_en: OasisLMF is the open-source catastrophe modelling framework (Loss Modelling Framework): a standard open platform for earthquake/storm/flood loss modelling, widely adopted in the industry as the open alternative to commercial RMS/Verisk models. For RIAA: core tool awareness for the catastrophe-modelling career path (the [[catastrophe-modeler]] role entry) — self-hosted open catastrophe models; with the [[reinsurance]] concept and [[openirm]] (Solvency II) it forms an open risk-modelling stack.
e.body_hk: OasisLMF 是開源巨災建模框架（Loss Modelling Framework）：地震/風暴/洪水等巨災損失建模的標準開源平台，行業廣泛採用（商業 RMS/Verisk 模型的開源替代）。對 RIAA：巨災建模職業路徑（[[catastrophe-modeler]] 崗位詞條）的核心工具認知——開源自託管巨災模型；與 [[reinsurance]] 概念、[[openirm]]（Solvency II）構成「風險建模開源棧」。
